_summary_en: 38-room steel-frame hotel (9 floors, 712㎡) in Higashi-Ueno, Tokyo, 5 minutes from Ueno station. Asking ¥620M including tax; full-occupancy rent of ¥33.48M gives a 5.4% gross yield. Built August 2018 with rooms renovated in 2023. It is leased to an operator on a 10-year fixed term to August 2034, which transfers to the buyer. Check: the current rent is withheld until a meeting, and the 84.2% occupancy figure is reported by the operator, not verified.
